title: Leading-bit recurrence for multiplication columns
statement:
Let $t$ be a bit, let $a,b$ be finite bit strings, and let $n\ge 0$. If $C_j(a,b)=\sum_{p=0}^{|a|-1} [p\le j]a_p b_{j-p}$, where out-of-range bits are zero, and $V(w)=\sum_{i=0}^{|w|-1}2^i w_i$, then
\[\sum_{j=0}^{n}2^j C_j(t::a,b)=t\,V(b\mathbin{\upharpoonright}(n+1))+2\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}2^j C_j(a,b).\]
Here $b\mathbin{\upharpoonright}(n+1)$ denotes the prefix of $b$ of length at most $n+1$.
